about_title: Horizontal presses with a tool for every bend
about_text: NovoTech's premium-line HP horizontal presses are built in Turkey to our specification. They bend, punch, shear, notch and straighten flat bar, pipe, solid bar and busbar with the part lying flat on the table — NC-controlled from 11 to 165 US tons, with a touch-screen recipe control, an optional servo back gauge and an extensive library of bending, punching, shearing, pipe and busbar tools; the HP 120 and HP 150 add a T-slot table and hardened support columns for straightening heavy sections.

NovoTech sells, installs and supports the HP presses in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada — tooling chosen for your parts, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
made_in: Made in Turkey for NovoTech's premium line — with European hydraulics and controls
